description: ACCDB: Cross-engine DDL (CREATE TABLE / DROP TABLE) visibility & refresh while both DAO Database and ADO Connection stay open. ADO creates CrossAdo -> DAO held TableDefs before/after Refresh & SELECT; DAO creates CrossDao -> ADO SELECT & OpenSchema(adSchemaTables); ADO drops CrossDao -> DAO TableDefs & SELECT; DAO drops CrossAdo -> ADO SELECT & OpenSchema. Keeps all pages before/after every DDL and close.
